scope: Evaluation transport diagnostics and stopped-ledger cause propagation only

changes.result: Exact observed routing timeout -> CLI_ROUTING_TIMEOUT; explicit connection codes -> CLI_CONNECTION_ERROR; explicit schema rejection codes -> CLI_SCHEMA_REJECTED; unknown error/turn.failed -> CLI_ERROR_EVENT/CLI_TURN_FAILED. All remain terminal.

The stopped-ledger guard propagates the first stable failure code and a cause with phase, ledger code and reason SHA-256, rather than replacing it with ERR_ASSERTION. The first persisted stop is never overwritten by later cancellation or guard errors.
No raw free-form failure text is copied to the new top-level cause. Existing bounded/redacted private diagnostics retain the original event.
Six integration checks now expect CLI_TURN_FAILED for their verified synthetic turn.failed fixture; fixtures and workflow rules are unchanged.

coverage: Historical 88-byte event reconstructed with exact original hash
Authoritative usage retained; missing or conflicting usage remains unknown
Local supervisor -> real broker -> ledger -> session cause propagation
Deliberately repeated local application request denied without a second transport dispatch
Actual session guard persists the first cause for both known and unknown usage
Credentials and free-form ledger text not copied into the new top-level cause
Actual old seal rejects modified checkout before authorization consumption or any CLI spawn
First recorded failure survives later deadline, STOP and clock reversal; changed run/ledger identities cannot supply a trusted cause
Current time is sampled after integrity validation; expiry during validation still stops before further action
validation.limits: The six Electron integration matrices were not rerun; their changed assertions were inspected against their actual fixtures. The new end-to-end regression uses a local Node process through the actual broker/ledger/session, with the transport input replaced by the saved event. The live-entry unit substitutes package lookup only; actual seal verification is retained.

nextStep.recommendation: After independent review, upload the diagnostic patch. Before any new real request, separately seal and review the updated minimal executor and present a fresh execution plan and budget. Preserve the successful F04 proof and all closed rounds. Do not change semantic standards or add automatic retries.

reviewFixes.finding: A deadline checked before the already-failed ledger replaced the first cause with ERR_ASSERTION.
reviewFixes.resolution: Validate run/prior evidence and the ledger first; preserve its existing terminal cause. When no terminal ledger stop exists, sample current time after validation and enforce the original deadline/clock/STOP guards.
